definition: A tangible object, material, or physical impression is documented as evidence.
Biological material or DNA evidence is documented.
Digital, computer, electronic, or database information/device is documented as evidence.
A written, recorded, official, financial, or other documentary item is documented as evidence.
A relevant letter, message, email, statement, confession, or other communication is documented.
The evidence item is specifically associated with a documented location or crime scene.
Scientific or technical forensic examination or analysis is documented.
A witness, victim, investigator, or suspect statement/testimony is documented.
Financial, accounting, investment, banking, or transaction evidence is documented.
